text:
Rae - CSM: FYI AstraNova onboarding: their beta is live and they're seeing intermittent spikes in tail latency during batch imports. Average prompt length ~22 tokens but some async batched jobs hit seq 150+. They asked if we can lower costs before they expand.

Noah - ML Eng: Short/short + occasional long batched jobs -> candidate for mixed routing: small requests to compact-int4, long sequences to fp16 or dedicated pool. Quantization to int4 could cut token costs substantially but we need to validate quality on their payment reconciliation prompts.

Elena - SuccessOps: Proposal: start with a "split-by-length" routing rule + 3% exploratory int4 traffic for short requests. Monitor quality on 1k sample responses. Also enable prefix cache for repeated confirmation templates.

Dev - SRE: We should avoid hitting their SLA window. Add guard: only ramp int4 when p50 < 120ms and error_rate < 0.3% for 10m window. If p95 jumps or error_rate >= 0.5% -> instant rollback.

Noah - ML Eng: I'll generate a quick quality delta report. Plan: run inference for 1k curated samples across current model and int4 compact and compute BLEU/EM/embedding-similarity + manual spot-checks. Expect minor diffs on rare numeric-parsing prompts.

Rae - CSM: Good call. Can we give AstraNova a simple one-pager that explains safeguards and rollback so their infra team is comfortable? I'll send invite for a 30m sync on Tuesday.

Elena - SuccessOps: I'll craft the one-pager and include troubleshooting steps + host a short ops walkthrough. Also capture acceptance criteria for renewal: 10-20% cost reduction OR p95 improvement >=12% with <=0.8% quality regression.

Noah - ML Eng: Sample routing config we suggest pushing to Console (dry-run first):

```
route_rules:
  - name: astranova-length-split
    match: "request.tokens <= 48"
    target_model: gpt-compact-int4-v1
    fallback: gpt-compact-fp16-v1
    sample_rate: 0.03
  - name: astranova-long-path
    match: "request.tokens > 48"
    target_model: gpt-standard-fp16-v2
    fallback: gpt-standard-fp16-v2
    priority: high
slo_guards:
  p50_threshold_ms: 120
  p95_threshold_ms: 900
  error_rate_threshold: 0.5
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl_seconds: 300
monitoring:
  quality_checks: [bleu, embedding_similarity]
  lookback_window: 1h
```

Dev - SRE: ops-bot -> create canary workspace and alert policy for the new route. ops-bot: please link runbook and attach the rollback action.

ops-bot: created workspace 'astranova-canary-3129000000', alert policy 'astranova-canary-aps' and runbook /runbooks/astranova-int4-rollback. Dry-run URL: /canaries/3129000000/preview

Noah - ML Eng: I'll post the 1k-sample report here tomorrow. If quality is within thresholds, we can ramp to 15% during off-peak and schedule 24h full-sweep test.

Rae - CSM: Thanks everyone. Action items: Noah -> sample report + perf delta; Elena -> one-pager + ops walkthrough; Dev -> set alerts and dry-run; Rae -> coordinate Tuesday sync with AstraNova. Will record outcomes for renewal conversation. :white_check_mark:
